title: Choose the visual world for the new portfolio
question: The roll assigned the Painted Signboard. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Painted Signboard
options.lineage: Tamil Nadu hand-painted enamel shop signs
options.thesis: Your name in Tamil above English, your proof lettered in rows, your number painted large: the sign asks them to call.
materials: hand lettering with black drop shadow
options.viewport: One full-width painted board: Tamil name, Latin name, trade line 'Lead Software Engineer · Bangalore · since 2021', painted proof rows (1.25M monthly users · 23 languages; Tibco→AWS Glue $24k→$840/yr), and the phone/WhatsApp number painted large as the only vermilion element, a working tel:/wa.me/email action. On first scroll the board letters itself in, stroke order, one continuous emergence.
options.risk: A hiring manager may read it as a designer's costume before the engineering proof lands; timid lettering or proof below the fold turns it into a poster.

raised.raise: Vermilion belongs to exactly one element: the painted number you call.
The brightest white is reserved for the focused element only.
The signature reveal is one continuous emergence, never scattered effects.
A painted menu board lists every section and is always one step away.
The 96% cost-cut figure is the page's one solid-black panel.
Buttons are painted boards that visibly press and flatten when disabled.

options.label: The Decision Record
options.thesis: Your career as numbered decision records: context, options weighed, decision, consequences, reviewed-by.
options.viewport: ADR-001 'Replace Tibco with AWS Glue' open on the page: status ACCEPTED, context, three options with pros and cons, the decision, consequences ($24k→$840/yr, delivered before contract end), reviewed-by Jason Wheeler and John Squier with their words. The index of all records sits beside it; 'Request a conversation' is the one form on the page.
options.risk: The familiar destination for engineering-minded portfolios; reads dry if the records are not set with real typographic character.

options.label: The 2 a.m. Bulletin Board
options.thesis: Every section a numbered text screen; the title pours in at modem speed; presence is scarce.
options.viewport: Title art 'MUBARAK' in block characters, then a numbered menu: [1] Proof [2] Witnesses [3] Experience [4] Projects [5] Call. Keyboard-complete.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: nine witnesses become message posts, proof becomes a stats screen; holds clarity (absolute reading order) but loses identification: it is the terminal costume this category already wears.
options.risk: Reads as retro novelty and as the saturated 'terminal portfolio' unless the cell grid is strict and the content dense.

options.label: Rain-Night Cityscape
options.lineage: blue hour to rain-dark urban nocturne
options.thesis: Bangalore at blue hour, your pipelines as transit veins.
options.viewport: Skyline band over street band over reflection band.
options.case: Atmosphere hides the proof; hiring managers do not identify with a nocturne, and it sits next to the dark-mode default.
options.kept: One material reserved for exactly one element.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from the moody dark portfolio.

options.label: Luminescent Understory
options.thesis: Paths light themselves two steps ahead of the pointer.
options.viewport: A glowing vein network with labels blooming beside growths.
options.case: No identification for a hiring audience; proximity-reveal navigation hides content from a 60-second scan.
options.kept: The brightest value belongs only to the focused element.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight
options.thesis: Proof develops in the tray; pull it too early and it is lost.
options.viewport: Stations in order: compose, expose, develop, fix.
options.case: Deliberateness resonates with 'presents options with pros and cons', but amber monochrome and slow emergence fight the scan.
options.kept: The signature reveal is one continuous emergence.
options.risk: Slow reveal reads as an artistic preloader.

options.label: Weekly Manga Page
options.thesis: Panels pace the story; one solid-black panel is the decisive beat.
options.viewport: Right-to-left panel grid with a bleed at the peak.
options.case: Right-to-left reading and bubble dialogue cost this audience clarity; no identification.
options.kept: Solid fill reserved for the one decisive beat.

options.label: CD-ROM Console
options.thesis: A fixed machine with a postcard-sized window; every button pushes in.
options.viewport: Console chrome around a small content window.
options.case: 'No free-flowing text anywhere' cannot carry nine testimonials or the about copy.
options.kept: Controls visibly press; disabled ones flatten.
options.risk: Content trapped in a tiny window.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The single-column developer portfolio: hero, proof numbers, projects, testimonials, contact, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Photo and headline, three stat tiles, project cards, testimonial cards, contact strip.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
